subject.title: fix: normalize provider keys during model config merge

question: Should generated models.json planning treat provider IDs as case-insensitive canonical identities and collapse case-variant stored keys?
rationale: The patch correctly follows the shared provider-ID contract and closes a credential-persistence gap, but accepting how pre-existing case-colliding records resolve requires maintainer ownership of the compatibility and secret-boundary behavior.

options.title: Accept Canonical IDs
options.body: Land the focused fix and treat normalized lowercase provider IDs as the single generated models.json identity.

options.title: Reject Collisions
options.body: Add a diagnostic when multiple stored keys normalize to the same provider ID before generated config is written.

options.title: Coordinate Broader Work
options.body: Pause and combine this identity behavior with the wider models.json credential-persistence effort.

recommendation.title: Accept Canonical IDs
recommendation.body: Land the focused fix and treat normalized lowercase provider IDs as the single generated models.json identity.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal is the adjacent source-snapshot and SecretRef persistence work in the same files and security boundary.
